Two-way Zapier integration: 74 real-time triggers, actions that write back to your store, and a delivery log with automatic retries.

","description":"

Connect Your Store To Thousands Of Apps, In Both Directions

Zapier Connector for WooCommerce sends store events to Zapier the moment they happen, and lets your Zaps write back. An order is paid, a subscription renews, stock runs low: the event reaches your Zap in seconds, carrying the same fields as the WooCommerce REST API. In the other direction, Zaps create and update customers, coupons, products, orders and notes on your store. Between the two, every delivery and every inbound action lands in an activity log where “did it fire?” takes five seconds to answer.

It ships with its own app on the Zapier platform, so your triggers work on Zapier’s free plan and the trigger list in the Zap editor is read live from your store, your custom order statuses included.

Key Benefits

  • React The Moment It Happens – 74 real-time triggers across orders, products, customers, coupons and notes, including one per order status and per stock status; no polling, no fifteen-minute wait
  • Your Statuses, By Name – The Zap editor’s trigger list is read live from your store, so a custom “Awaiting pickup” status is one click, not a workaround
  • Checkout Never Waits – Deliveries run through the WooCommerce queue, off the customer’s request; failures retry on their own after 5 minutes, 30 minutes, then 2 hours
  • Automation In Both Directions – Zaps create and update store data with the same field names as the WooCommerce REST API, and find records by email, SKU, coupon code or order number
  • Switch Without Rebuilding Your Zaps – The importer converts webhooks created by a previous Zapier extension into feeds aimed at the same Zapier URLs, so existing Zaps keep running untouched
  • Nothing Disappears Silently – Every delivery and inbound action is logged with status and duration, failed deliveries can be resent in one click, and a feed that keeps failing pauses itself and says so

Main Features

74 Triggers That Fire In Real Time

Orders: created, updated, paid, deleted, restored, status changed, and one trigger per order status. Products and variations: created, updated, deleted, restored, stock low, stock status changed, and one trigger per stock status. Customers, coupons and order notes complete the core set. Each event delivers the full object as your store’s REST API describes it, so the fields you map in Zapier are the fields your store actually carries.

A Native Zapier App

Zapier Connector pairs with its own app on the Zapier platform. Connecting takes a store URL, a username and an application password. Turning a Zap on subscribes it to your store automatically; turning it off unsubscribes. The editor’s test step pulls real recent orders so you map real fields, and native app triggers work on Zapier’s free plan.

Subscriptions, Bookings And Memberships, Detected

Run WooCommerce Subscriptions, Bookings or Memberships? Their triggers and actions appear on their own: renewals and failed renewals, switches, booking confirmations and cancellations, membership transfers and pauses, one trigger per status throughout. Forty-four additional events, zero configuration.

Actions And Searches For Write-Back Flows

Create and update customers, coupons, products, orders, subscriptions and memberships from any Zap. Add order and subscription notes, private or customer-facing. Find a customer by email, a product by SKU, a coupon by code, an order by its number, so “find or create” flows chain naturally. A curated field set covers the common cases and an open field accepts any WooCommerce REST API field.

An Activity Log Built For Trust

Every outbound delivery and every inbound action, newest first, with HTTP status, attempt number and duration. Resend any delivery with its original payload in one click. Failures retry on a backoff schedule, and a feed that fails repeatedly deactivates itself with a note explaining how to recover, instead of hammering a dead Zap forever.

Built For The Assistant Era

Nine tools registered with the WordPress Abilities API let an MCP-connected AI assistant inspect and manage the integration under your permissions: list triggers, create and pause feeds, read the delivery history, resend a failed delivery. “Why didn’t my Zap run yesterday?” becomes a question your assistant can answer.

How It Works

  • Install And Enable – Activate the plugin and find its settings under WooCommerce, Settings, Advanced, Zapier; one master switch turns the whole integration on and off
  • Connect From Zapier – In the Zap editor, pick the Zapier Connector app, connect with an application password, choose a trigger rule from your store’s own list, and test with real records
  • Or Use A Catch Hook – Prefer Webhooks by Zapier? Create a feed in the settings, paste the Catch Hook URL, press Send sample so the editor sees real fields to map
  • Switching From Another Extension? – The importer detects webhooks delivering to Zapier, recreates them as feeds aimed at the same URLs, and disables the originals so nothing is delivered twice
  • Watch It Run – The Activity tab shows every delivery and inbound action as it happens, with retries and resends at hand

How Does It Compare To Other Zapier Plugins For WooCommerce?

There are three ways to connect WooCommerce to Zapier: the long-standing Zapier Integration extension, hand-made WooCommerce webhooks paired with Webhooks by Zapier, and Zapier Connector. The differences that matter are how triggers reach Zapier, what happens when a delivery fails, and how much of the setup you can see and control from your store.

Zapier Connector Zapier Integration (Tectalic) Manual webhooks + Webhooks by Zapier
Real-time triggers 74, including per-status Comparable coverage across the same resources Core WooCommerce topics only
Works on Zapier’s free plan Yes, native app triggers Yes, native app triggers No, Webhooks by Zapier is a premium app
Trigger list reflects custom statuses Yes, read live from the store Yes No, core topics are fixed
Delivery log in the store Yes, with one-click resend and inbound actions logged Yes, task history No
Failed feed handling Retries with backoff, then pauses itself with a recovery note Relies on WooCommerce webhook auto-disable Relies on WooCommerce webhook auto-disable
Import from an existing setup Yes, one click, existing Zaps keep running Not applicable Not applicable
AI assistant tools on the store (MCP) Nine, via the WordPress Abilities API Not stated; Zapier’s own MCP product works with any Zapier app, either way Not applicable
Subscriptions, Bookings, Memberships Yes, detected automatically Yes Partial, core webhook topics only

Where the alternatives are genuinely strong, plainly: Zapier Integration by Tectalic has been on the market for over a decade, its Zapier app is long established, and its trigger coverage on the same resources is comparable; if you already run it and it serves you, switching is a choice, not a need. Manual webhooks cost nothing at the store level and suit a developer wiring a single event. Zapier Connector’s case is the store-side experience: the activity log with resend, feeds that pause themselves instead of failing silently, the one-click importer when you do decide to switch, and AI-assistant management out of the box.

Who Is It For?

  • Stores Living In Spreadsheets And Chat – Every paid order lands in a sheet and pings the team channel, seconds after checkout
  • Subscription Businesses – A failed renewal opens a task in your CRM before the customer notices; a switch updates your accounting
  • Ops Teams That Automate Back – A form entry creates a coupon; a fulfilment update writes an order note the customer can see
  • Merchants Leaving Their Current Zapier Extension – The importer moves the whole setup in one click, and existing Zaps never notice

What You Get

  • The Plugin And The Zapier App – 74 triggers, 13 actions, 7 searches, the importer, the activity log and 9 MCP tools
  • Compatibility – WooCommerce 9.0 or higher, tested up to 11.0; High-Performance Order Storage and Cart and Checkout blocks supported
  • Requirements – A Zapier account; the free plan works with the native app’s triggers
  • Updates And Support – One year of updates and support, with a 30-day money-back guarantee

[{"id":18734006804802,"name":"Advanced Shipping","slug":"advanced-shipping","parent":0,"type":"simple","variation":"","permalink":"https://woocommerce.com/products/advanced-shipping/","sku":"","short_description":"

Conditional shipping rates with limitless capabilities.

","description":"
  • Create condition based shipping rates
  • Offer accurate shipping rates based on your store’s requirements
  • Charge shipping cost based on advanced weight, shipping class, category and product configurations
  • Create shipping rates within and outside the Shipping Zones

Advanced Shipping is the perfect solution for store owners who have specific shipping requirements that go beyond Woo’s native capabilities. Creating configurations based on conditions will provide you with the most versatile way of creating the shipping rates that will fit your needs.

For example if you wish to setup shipping rates based on the item quantity, which items are in the cart, the total weight of the cart, or the weight of specific (group of) items, product specifications and the list goes on and on…

 

Example use cases for Advanced Shipping

  • Free shipping per product, shipping class or category
  • Show / hide shipping rates based on cart amount, weight, quantity, stock status, cart contents and more!
  • Restrict shipping of certain items (or category / shipping classes) to certain regions (zipcode, city, state, country, continent)
  • Set shipping cost based on cart, product, shipping class or category weight
  • Show different rates based on user role

Conditional Shipping Rates

Advanced Shipping comes with a wide variety of conditions. A full list of available conditions:

 

Cart User details Product
Subtotal
Subtotal excluding taxes
Tax
Quantity
Contains product
Coupon
Weight
Contains shipping class		 Zipcode
City
State
Country
User role		 Width
Height
Length
Stock
Stock status
Category

Add as many ‘OR’ condition groups as you wish within a shipping rate. All Advanced Shipping rates will appear that match ALL the conditions within one condition group.

Extending with custom conditions

Is the condition you need not available? The plugin can be extended easily through the available hooks and filters.

Advanced Pricing

Through the Advanced Pricing functionality the Advanced Shipping rate can be assigned the most versatile shipping cost. Within this section you’ll find options to setup shipping cost by Weight, Shipping cost by Shipping Class, Shipping cost by Category and Shipping cost by Product.

Each section has their unique features. For example you can setup cost for each additional weight unit (rounding up or down). Shipping cost per product, class and category can have a table rate based on the selected item(s) weight, quantity or subtotal.

The fee is configurable to flat fees, percentages, percentage of the selected item(s), as a multiplier or a negative/discounted amount.

Read more about all the features in the documentation.

Let customers calculate shipping costs on product pages using store’s own shipping methods and real-time FedEx rates.

","description":"

Highlights

  • Display a shipping calculator directly on WooCommerce product pages
  • Easily display the shipping method and estimated cost before checkout
  • Support both single and multiple products’ shipping calculations
  • Display real-time FedEx shipping rates with FedEx integration
  • Restrict the calculator based on specific user roles, product types, categories, tags, and brands
  • Display the calculator as an in-page section or in the form of a popup
  • Customize the calculator button, colors, layout, and position
  • View detailed features

Customers often want to know the shipping cost before they decide to buy a product. If your store is still showing shipping charges at checkout, many shoppers can leave the cart abandoned, as it creates a frustrating shopping experience.

Shipping Calculator on Product Page for WooCommerce can overcome this problem by displaying shipping costs directly on the product page. Customers can choose an available shipping method and instantly view the shipping charges and estimated delivery cost before adding products to their cart. It allows customers to select both single products and multiple products and calculate the shipping and estimated cost based on the selected items.

With this feature, you can choose how the shipping calculator appears by displaying it directly on the product page or opening it in a popup. You can also control its availability by restricting it to specific user roles, products, categories, brands, or tags. Moreover, you can customize the calculator by adding its button text, button colors, calculator box, and display position that match your store’s design to create a seamless shopping experience.

Detailed Features of Shipping Calculator on Product Page for WooCommerce

Display a Shipping Calculator on Product Pages

With the Shipping Calculator on Product Page for WooCommerce, you can display a shipping calculator directly on product pages, which allows customers to calculate the shipping costs before checkout. Customers can choose the available shipping method and view the calculated shipping charges without leaving the product page. Additionally, it also supports both single and multiple products to calculate shipping costs based on selected items to create a fast and efficient shopping experience.

Calculate Real-Time FedEx Shipping Rates Before Checkout

This feature allows customers to calculate and view the real-time FedEx shipping rates directly on the product page before checkout. Simply, the customers can enter their shipping address, choose a preferred FedEx shipping service, and see the available FedEx shipping options along with their estimated shipping costs. By showing the accurate shipping charges in advance, you can increase customer purchasing decisions and avoid unexpected shipping costs at checkout.

Restrict the Shipping Calculator by Roles, Categories, Tags, Brands & Product Types

With the Product Page Shipping Calculator for WooCommerce, take complete control over where the shipping calculator is displayed. It allows you to restrict the calculator based on specific user roles, products, product types, categories, tags, or brands. This flexibility can control who can access the shipping calculator and provide a customized shopping experience.

Customize the Shipping Calculator Button, Colors, Layout & Position

The Shipping Calculator on Product Page for WooCommerce allows you to control the calculator’s appearance by adding the custom button text, button color, text color, border radius, calculator box color, and box shadow to match your store’s design. Additionally, you can also choose where to display the shipping calculator, such as displayed above or below the Add to Cart button or the product description, to make it easier for customers to access.

Display the Shipping Calculator as a Popup or In-Page

Easily choose the display style, such as displaying the shipping calculator directly on the product page for quick access or showing it in a popup to maintain a clean and organized product page layout. This gives customers an easy way to estimate shipping costs and maintain a smooth shopping experience without affecting the product page layout.

More Features

  • Easily enable or disable the calculator at any time
  • Set the display position calculator like
    • Display In-page
    • Display Pop-up
  • Customize the button style by adding
    • Button text
    • Border Radius
    • Color
    • Background Color
  • Control the display position of the product page, such as
    • Above Add-to-Cart button
    • Below Add-to-Cart button
    • Above Description of product
  • Customize the calculator box by adding
    • Custom text color
    • Custom Background color
    • Custom Border color
    • Set Shadow
  • Add the custom CSS for additional styling
  • Integrate your FedEx shipping account with your store by
    • Add your FedEx Shipping Account Number
    • Configure the REST API Key and Secret for secure authentication
    • Add the Production API Key to retrieve live shipping rates
    • Select the Box Packer Library to calculate package dimensions for accurate shipping rates
  • Enable LTL Freight shipping for eligible FedEx freight accounts
  • Turn on Debug Mode for troubleshooting and API diagnostics

WcMultiShipping is a plugin that integrates Mondial Relay and Chronopost shipping services into WooCommerce, streamlining your shipping process, automating label generation, and allowing customers to choose their preferred delivery method during checkout.

Key Features:

  • Seamless Mondial Relay Integration: Effortlessly add Mondial Relay shipping methods to your WooCommerce store, allowing customers to select pickup points or home delivery options during checkout.
  • Automatic Label Generation: Generate shipping labels automatically for Mondial Relay and Chronopost orders directly from your WooCommerce admin panel, reducing the time spent on manual tasks.
  • Flexible Shipping Rates: Customize shipping costs based on cart total, order weight, or specific shipping zones, ensuring that your customers always get the best rates.
  • Advanced Configuration Options: Access detailed settings for each shipping method, including default insurance amounts, preparation times, and handling fees.
  • Google Maps Integration: Display Mondial Relay pickup points using Google Maps during checkout, giving your customers a clear and easy way to select their preferred location.

Why Choose WcMultiShipping?

  • Enhanced Customer Experience: Offering multiple delivery options, including the widely recognized Mondial Relay service, improves customer satisfaction and increases conversion rates.
  • Time-Saving Automation: With automatic label generation and seamless integration into WooCommerce, you can focus on growing your business while we handle the logistics.
  • Optimized for WooCommerce: WcMultiShipping is built to work flawlessly with WooCommerce, ensuring a smooth experience for both store owners and customers.

Available Mondial Relay Shipping Methods:

  • Mondial Relay – Point Relais: Customers can choose to have their orders delivered to a nearby pickup point.
  • Mondial Relay – Colis Drive: Perfect for customers who prefer to pick up their orders from a drive-through location.
  • Mondial Relay – Home Delivery (1 or 2 Deliverers): Offers the convenience of home delivery with the option for one or two deliverers, ideal for heavier packages.
  • Mondial Relay – Home Delivery < 30kg: Specialized for packages weighing under 30kg, ensuring fast and efficient delivery.

Available Chronopost Shipping Methods:

  • Chronopost 10: Guaranteed delivery by 10 AM the next day.
  • Chronopost 13: Delivery by 1 PM the next day.
  • Chronopost 18: End of day delivery option.
  • Chronopost Classic: Standard delivery with no time commitment.
  • Chronopost Express: Fast, reliable express delivery service.
  • Chronopost Relais: Convenient delivery to local pickup points.
  • Chronopost Relais Domicile: Combined service of home delivery and pickup point options.
  • Chronopost Relais Europe: Cross-border delivery within Europe.
  • Chronopost Same Day: Urgent same-day delivery service.

Adjustment","slug":"ph-hide-shipping-methods-and-rate-adjustment","parent":0,"type":"simple","variation":"","permalink":"https://woocommerce.com/products/ph-hide-shipping-methods-and-rate-adjustment/","sku":"","short_description":"

Conditionally hide shipping methods and adjust shipping rates in WooCommerce based on products, cart conditions, locations, user roles, coupons, and more.

","description":"

PH Hide Shipping Methods and Rate Adjustment for WooCommerce — Control which shipping methods customers see and adjust shipping rates dynamically based on your store’s rules

PH Hide Shipping Methods and Rate Adjustment gives you complete control over which shipping options are displayed at checkout and how shipping costs are adjusted based on your business rules. Whether you want to hide expensive shipping methods, display free shipping only under certain conditions, or modify shipping charges dynamically, the plugin helps you create a cleaner and more optimized checkout experience.

Hide WooCommerce shipping methods based on real business conditions

WooCommerce displays all available shipping methods by default, but real-world shipping requirements are rarely that simple. With this plugin, you can conditionally hide shipping methods based on:

  • Cart subtotal
  • Total order weight
  • Product quantity
  • Product categories
  • Shipping classes
  • Shipping Zones, destination country, state, or postcode
  • Shipping Methods
  • Day, date, or time
  • User roles
  • Applied coupons

This allows you to control exactly which shipping options customers see at checkout.

Hide other methods when free shipping is available

Free shipping should stand out—not compete with unnecessary shipping options. The plugin allows you to automatically hide other shipping methods when free shipping becomes available, creating a cleaner checkout experience and helping customers make faster decisions.   This is especially useful for promotional campaigns and free shipping thresholds.

Adjust shipping rates dynamically on the WooCommerce cart and checkout page

Shipping costs often need to change depending on the order or customer. Using rate adjustment rules, you can:

  • Increase or decrease shipping charges
  • Apply flat-rate adjustments
  • Add percentage-based shipping costs
  • Modify shipping rates based on coupons or cart conditions

This gives you greater flexibility to align shipping charges with operational costs and marketing strategies.

Create advanced shipping logic without custom code

Complex shipping workflows usually require custom development—but not anymore. You can combine multiple conditions to create advanced shipping rules. For example:

  • Hide express shipping for low-value orders
  • Display local pickup only for selected products
  • Hide carrier-calculated rates for specific destinations
  • Show free shipping only when quantity thresholds are met

Advanced rules help you tailor checkout behavior to match your exact business requirements.

Configure location-based shipping visibility

Different destinations often require different shipping options. You can hide or display shipping methods based on:

  • Shipping Zones
  • Countries
  • States or regions
  • ZIP/postcodes

This helps you manage regional restrictions, delivery limitations, and location-specific shipping strategies more effectively.

Customize shipping by products and categories

Not all products should use the same shipping methods. The plugin allows you to configure shipping visibility based on:

  • Product categories
  • Shipping classes

This is especially useful for bulky, fragile, oversized, or restricted items.

Improve checkout clarity and reduce cart abandonment

Too many shipping options can overwhelm customers. By showing only the most relevant shipping methods and adjusting rates intelligently, you can create a cleaner checkout experience that reduces confusion and helps customers complete purchases faster. This is particularly effective when hiding expensive or unnecessary shipping options during checkout.

Control how carrier-specific services are displayed on the WooCommerce cart and checkout page

If you use carrier-calculated shipping plugins, you can go beyond hiding entire methods. The plugin also allows you to hide specific shipping services returned by carriers, such as:

  • UPS
  • FedEx
  • DHL
  • USPS

For example, you can hide premium express services for low-cart-value orders or suppress expensive delivery options for selected regions.

Manage shipping rules more efficiently

As your store grows, managing shipping conditions becomes more complex. The plugin provides a centralized interface to:

  • Create and manage multiple rules
  • Edit, copy, or delete existing configurations
  • Organize advanced shipping conditions efficiently

This makes it easier to maintain and scale your shipping setup over time.

Built to work seamlessly with WooCommerce

PH Hide Shipping Methods and Rate Adjustment integrates directly into WooCommerce and works alongside both default and carrier-calculated shipping methods. You can configure rules without coding and adapt shipping behavior without changing your existing fulfillment workflow.

Ideal for:

  • Stores offering free shipping promotions
  • Businesses using carrier-calculated shipping rates
  • Stores with region-specific shipping restrictions
  • Merchants wanting to reduce checkout clutter
  • Businesses needing advanced conditional shipping logic

Labels","slug":"qc-pdf-invoices-pro","parent":0,"type":"simple","variation":"","permalink":"https://woocommerce.com/products/qc-pdf-invoices-pro/","sku":"","short_description":"

Automatically generate professional PDF invoices, shipping labels, credit notes, and delivery notes for your WooCommerce store. Attach PDFs to order emails, let customers download from My Account, run bulk operations, and choose from 8 branded invoice templates — all with zero coding required.

","description":"

Stop Sending Plain-Text Order Confirmations

Your customers expect professional documentation. Every completed order should come with a properly formatted PDF invoice, automatically — not as an afterthought you handle manually.

QuarkCode PDF Invoices Pro handles the full document lifecycle of your WooCommerce store: from automatic invoice generation and email delivery, to shipping labels with barcodes, monthly consolidated statements, and refund credit notes. Everything stays on your server. Nothing leaves your WordPress installation.

Invoices That Generate Themselves

The moment an order reaches “processing” or “completed” status, a PDF invoice is generated and attached to the customer’s email — no button to press, no manual exports. You configure once, and the plugin works in the background on every order from that point forward.

Customers can also view or download their invoices directly from the My Account page, reducing your support inbox load significantly.

Professional Templates, Ready to Use

Choose from 8 carefully designed invoice templates built for different brand aesthetics:

  • Default — clean, universal
  • Bold Modern — strong typography, high contrast
  • Classic Elegant — serif-driven, refined
  • Corporate Professional — structured, formal
  • Creative Contemporary — fresh, expressive
  • Modern Minimalist — whitespace-first design
  • Refund Theme — purpose-built for credit notes
  • Consolidated Monthly — multi-order statement layout

Every template supports your company logo, custom header and footer text, payment terms, and multiple paper sizes including A4, A5, A3, Letter, and Legal.

Shipping Labels with Barcodes and QR Codes

Generate print-ready shipping labels directly from the order page, individually or in bulk. Choose from 6 shipping label templates — Default, Classic, Minimalist, Premium, Professional, and a legacy original — and configure your return address, paper size, and orientation.

Labels support barcode and QR code generation, making them ready for carrier scan systems out of the box. Set a custom label numbering format with your own prefix, suffix, and sequential counter, separate from your invoice numbering.

Monthly Consolidated Invoices for B2B Stores

B2B customers often need a single monthly statement covering all their orders, rather than individual per-order invoices. The consolidated invoice engine generates these automatically via WP-Cron on a schedule you control, or you can trigger them manually with customer and date filters.

Customers access their monthly invoices from a dedicated “Monthly Invoices” section in My Account. You can bulk email statements directly to customers, bulk download them as a ZIP archive, or delete batches from the admin panel.

Credit Notes on Every Refund

When an order is refunded in WooCommerce, the plugin automatically generates a credit note and can attach it to the refund email. Credit notes use their own numbering sequence and template (including a red theme variant for visual distinction), and customers can view or download them from their account.

Delivery Notes for Fulfillment Teams

Enable delivery notes to accompany shipments. Configure whether prices are shown, whether product images are included, and which order statuses trigger automatic generation. A dedicated email can be sent to the customer with the delivery note attached, keeping your warehouse and customer communication aligned.

Bulk Operations for High-Volume Stores

From the WooCommerce Orders list, select multiple orders and run bulk actions:

  • Generate invoices for a batch of orders in one click
  • Download all selected invoices as a single ZIP file
  • Email invoices to customers in bulk
  • Generate or download shipping labels in bulk, with date-range filtering
  • Delete batches of consolidated invoices

Custom Invoice Numbering

Decouple your invoice numbers from WooCommerce order IDs. Set a custom format, prefix (e.g., INV-), suffix, and starting counter. The system maintains its own sequential count independently, with duplicate prevention built in so a number is never assigned twice.

Full HPOS Compatibility

Fully compatible with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS / Custom Order Tables), ensuring stable performance as WooCommerce continues evolving its data architecture.

Translation Ready — French Included

Ships with a complete French translation (700+ strings) and a full POT file for any additional language. All text in the plugin passes through WordPress’s standard translation system, making it compatible with WPML, Polylang, and any other multilingual setup.

Your Data Stays on Your Server

No external API calls for PDF generation. All documents are created and stored locally using the bundled DomPDF library. Customer data never leaves your WordPress installation.

","description":"

PH Advanced Table Rate Shipping — Set up flexible, rule-based shipping rates for your WooCommerce store with ease

PH Advanced Table Rate Shipping lets you define precise shipping costs based on weight, price, quantity, destination, product category, and more—so you can charge exactly what makes sense for your business. Whether you need simple flat rates or complex shipping logic, this plugin gives you complete control over how shipping is calculated at checkout.

Why use PH Advanced Table Rate Shipping?

Shipping isn’t one-size-fits-all. Different products, locations, and order sizes often require different shipping costs.

With table rate shipping, you can create structured rules to calculate shipping dynamically—helping you:

  • Avoid undercharging or overcharging
  • Offer fair and transparent rates to customers
  • Improve conversions with accurate shipping costs

This plugin is ideal for stores with varied product types, bulk orders, or region-specific pricing.

Set up shipping your way

Create multiple shipping rules using a simple table-based approach and apply them based on:

  • Order weight
  • Cart subtotal
  • Quantity of items
  • Shipping destination (country, state, zip/postcode)
  • Product categories or shipping classes

Instead of relying on a single flat rate, you can define exactly how shipping should behave for every scenario. The plugin works by letting you configure rules in a structured format, making it easy to manage even complex shipping requirements.

Key Features

Flexible rule-based shipping

Create unlimited shipping rules using combinations of:

  • Weight ranges
  • Price ranges
  • Quantity-based conditions
  • Destination-based conditions

Multiple shipping methods

Offer different shipping options like:

  • Standard shipping
  • Express shipping
  • Priority delivery

Each method can have its own set of rules and pricing.

Location-based shipping rates

Define shipping costs based on:

  • Countries
  • States/regions
  • Postcodes/ZIP codes

Perfect for businesses that ship internationally or have region-specific pricing.

Category & product-specific rules

Set shipping rates based on:

  • Product categories
  • Shipping classes
  • Individual products

Charge differently for bulky, fragile, or high-value items.

Advanced pricing logic

Handle complex scenarios such as:

  • Per item shipping costs
  • Incremental pricing (e.g., first item + additional items)
  • Tiered pricing based on order value or weight

Combine multiple conditions

Apply multiple conditions together to create highly customized shipping rules—for example:

  • Weight + destination
  • Quantity + product category
  • Price + shipping class

Import and export shipping rules

Save time and manage your shipping configurations more efficiently.

  • Export your shipping rules for backup or reuse
  • Import rules to quickly set up shipping on another store
  • Easily migrate configurations between environments

This is especially useful for agencies, developers, or stores managing multiple setups.

Seamless WooCommerce integration

Works directly within WooCommerce shipping zones and methods, so you can:

  • Assign rules to specific zones
  • Combine with other shipping methods
  • Control how options appear at checkout

Improve your checkout experience

By showing customers the right shipping cost based on their cart and location, you build trust and remove surprises at checkout—leading to better conversions and fewer support queries.

Built for growing stores

Whether you’re running a small store or managing large-scale operations with diverse products, PH Advanced Table Rate Shipping scales with your needs. From simple flat-rate adjustments to highly complex shipping strategies, you can configure everything in one place—without writing any code.

This plugin makes shipping easier. It lets you export order shipping data into ready-to-use CSV files that work directly with popular carriers like DHL, Hermes, Deutsche Post, and GLS—no manual editing required.

  • Save time on every shipment
    Export multiple orders at once in the exact format your carrier needs.

  • Reduce shipping errors
    Addresses and shipping details are automatically formatted to meet carrier requirements.

  • No more manual spreadsheets
    Stop copying, pasting, and fixing CSV files by hand—everything is prepared for you.

  • Works with your shipping setup
    Use different carriers and easily adjust sender information when needed.

  • Easy to use for everyone
    A clean, simple admin interface means no technical knowledge is required.

There is no built-in export tailored to the different CSV formats required by shipping providers. This often leads to manual work, wasted time, and avoidable mistakes.

This plugin solves that problem.
You select the orders, choose the carrier, and export a carrier-ready CSV file you can upload immediately.

Who Is This Plugin For?

  • Store owners

  • Shops shipping orders daily or in large volumes

  • Businesses using multiple shipping carriers

  • Anyone who wants faster, cleaner, and more reliable shipping workflows

The Result

Less admin work, fewer shipping issues, and a faster fulfillment process.
You spend less time managing shipping data—and your customers receive their orders on time, every time.
